FAQ.label: FAQ
FAQ.title: Questions You Might Have
FAQ.subtitle: Common questions about AI visibility monitoring and mairror.

items.question: What is AI brand visibility?
items.answer: AI brand visibility measures how often and how favorably your brand appears in AI-powered search results (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Bing Copilot). Unlike traditional SEO rankings, AI visibility tracks mention rates across prompt variants and platforms.

items.question: Which AI platforms do you monitor?
items.answer: We currently monitor Perplexity, ChatGPT (OpenAI), Claude (Anthropic), and Bing Copilot. We query each platform with 20-30 prompt variants per keyword to produce statistically meaningful visibility scores.

items.question: Do you track AI search rankings?
items.answer: No — and here's why: AI search results are non-deterministic. The same query can return different answers. Instead of 'rankings', we measure mention rate (how often your brand appears across prompt variants) and sentiment analysis.

items.question: How is this different from traditional SEO tools?
items.answer: Traditional SEO tools (Ahrefs, Semrush) focus on Google/Bing SERP positions and keyword rankings. mairror specifically measures visibility in AI chat platforms — which is an entirely different channel with different optimization requirements.

items.question: What does the technical readiness audit check?
items.answer: Our audit checks five dimensions: llms.txt presence and format, robots.txt AI directives, JSON-LD structured data completeness, Core Web Vitals performance, and content summarizability. Each dimension gets a score and specific fix recommendations.

items.question: Can you guarantee we'll appear in AI search results?
items.answer: No tool can guarantee AI visibility — these systems are inherently non-deterministic. What we can guarantee: we'll show you exactly what AI platforms currently say about your brand, how you compare to competitors, and the most impactful steps to improve your visibility.
